_about: A DIFFERENT VALLEY EVERY GAME (WORLD 7, rule 339, ask line 347; Paolo 11/3, again: 'the map is not giving procedurally generated vibes'). WORLD 6's campaign seed (records/target/bb/world_seed.json) moved WHO stands on the real valley; this file is WHAT STATE the valley is in and WHAT STANDS OUT THERE, from the same code: which blocks are dark, burned, looted or rebuilt; the camps, lairs, ruins and legendary places with a landmark you can see from far; the roads that are blocked and the passes that are closed; the sky he starts under. The land never moves (the Vegas geography law): every pick is a real block of the valley generator's own fixed land, of a kind that fits. Read by engine/bohemia_world_state.js (node and page); inlined into slices/BOHEMIA_CITY_WORLD.html as BOHEMIA_WORLD_STATE_DATA by tools/bohemia_world_state_patch.py; gates/a_different_valley_every_game_gate.js refuses a drift. Every number and every name here is ours, draft, for TUNING's table and WORDS' pass.

raided.quote: This place has been recently raided! It's suffered damage, has lost valuable goods and supplies, and lives were lost.

legendary.quote: Legendary locations are unique locations scattered over the world. They can be interacted with to get quests, information or items. While less remote locations are usually safe, the ones further away from civilization are more dangerous

same_seed_same_world.quote: Starting a new campaign with a same map seed will always generate the same map including locations and their named items

old_valley: a game with no code (the checkers' bench without a code) and a game saved before this file (its bohemia.world.v1 has no st) keep the valley exactly as it was: no state, no marks, no blocked road

keep_clear.why: a faction's own town and the street round it are never burned, looted or blocked: the town is the door, and a base you cannot walk into is a broken game

dark.what: THE POWER. Only some of the valley's circuits were ever live (the land seed's); each campaign puts a share of them out at the start, in whole neighbourhoods, never round a faction's base (they keep their own lights). A doused circuit is the grid's own dark (POWER.douse): the painting, the street lamps, the town and every 'is it black in here' reader see it. It is re-derived from the code at every boot and never written to the bill's dark set, so an unpaid bill stays the bill's.

burned.name: BURNED
burned.what: a fire's scar: the roofs gone to char, the street black with soot, an ember or two at night

board.why: a burned BUILT block deals the ruin board on the house ground (the firehouse is the one district that already fights there): the walls stand, the roofs are gone, the yard is rubble; burned open ground (desert, park, solar, farm) keeps its own board, scorched scrub is still scrub

looted.name: LOOTED
looted.what: a stripped strip: doors kicked in, glass out, the lot strewn with what was not worth carrying

reclaimed.name: REBUILT
reclaimed.what: a block a faction took back: panels on the roofs, a garden where the lawn was, its own lights at night

camp.what: a camp out on open ground: tarps, a cook fire; its smoke stands up over the valley by day and the fire glows at night

lair.what: where a lab beast sleeps: a wreck it dragged off the road, bones round it, the birds turning over it all day

ruin.what: a tall place that burned out: its shell still stands, black against the sky, nothing lit in it

legend.what: one of the valley's legendary places: a mast you can see from anywhere, its red light still blinking at night; Battle Brothers' unique locations

roads.what: a few freeway blocks are shut: a truck jackknifed across the lanes, an overpass come down, a faction's barricade. The whole width of the road is shut, so the route goes round; a block is only shut where the valley stays one piece (every street still reaches every other).
roads.from_bases_why: the centre 5 blocks off, so no shut block (the centre and the lanes touching it) comes nearer a base than 4: the keep-clear ring is 3

passes.what: the real roads out through the ranges (I-15, US-95, US-93, NV-160, NV-159, NV-147...): each campaign shuts one or two with a rockslide or a checkpoint; the land past it is still crossable over the rock, slowly

weather.what: the sky he starts under, for the first days; the map already carries the valley's dust inversion and the night wash, so each start is a wash over that same land
